easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Thassa's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Thassa's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.
